jp: やっぱりも、テスカトリポカに神の間に来いって言われた？
jp_grezzo: "やっぱり" + _kimi(3) + "も、テスカトリポカに神の間に来いって言われた" + _noka(3) + "？"
en: So Tezcatlipoca ordered you to come to the Eternal Seal as well?
en_grezzo: "So Tezcatlipoca ordered you to come to the Eternal Seal as well?"
it: Anche a te Tezcatlipoca ha detto di andare al Sigillo Eterno, eh?

jp: 調べによると、テスカトリポカはかつてエヘカトルと双璧をなす神だったらしい。けれど今では力を没収されてレベル200まで落ちぶれていると聞く。
jp_grezzo: "調べによると、テスカトリポカはかつてエヘカトルと双璧をなす神だったらしい" + _yo(3) + "。けれど今では力を没収されてレベル200まで落ちぶれていると聞く" + _na(3) + "。"
en: According to my research, Tezcatlipoca used to be a god who rivaled Ehekatl in power. But now, I've heard that his powers have been stripped and he's down to level 200.
en_grezzo: "According to my research, Tezcatlipoca used to be a god who rivaled Ehekatl in power. But now, I've heard that his powers have been stripped and he's down to level 200."
it: Dalle mie ricerche, Tezcatlipoca un tempo era un dio che stava alla pari con Ehekatl. Ma adesso, dicono, gli hanno confiscato la forza ed è caduto fino al livello 200.

jp: 夜と煙と戦争の神様だから、煙を撒いて翻弄しつつ闇討ち…という戦法を取ってくるかもしれない。広範囲に火柱や蜘蛛の巣、闇の霧などを撒けるものや爆発で煙をかき消さないと、一方的に殴られる。
jp_grezzo: "夜と煙と戦争の神様だから、煙を撒いて翻弄しつつ闇討ち…という戦法を取ってくるかもしれない。広範囲に火柱や蜘蛛の巣、闇の霧などを撒けるものや爆発で煙をかき消さないと、一方的に殴られる" + _daro(3) + "。"
en: Since he's the god of the night, smoke, and war, he might use the strategy of scattering smoke to toss you around and then strike in the dark.... If you don't drown out the smoke with something that can spread fire columns, spider webs, or dark mist over a large area, or use explosions to clear it out, you'll be beaten singlehandedly.
en_grezzo: "Since he's the god of the night, smoke, and war, he might use the strategy of scattering smoke to toss you around and then strike in the dark.... If you don't drown out the smoke with something that can spread fire columns, spider webs, or dark mist over a large area, or use explosions to clear it out, you'll be beaten singlehandedly."
it: È il dio della notte, del fumo e della guerra, quindi potrebbe usare la tattica di spargere fumo, farti girare a vuoto e colpirti al buio. Se non hai qualcosa che spanda su un'area larga colonne di fuoco, ragnatele o Nebbia d'oscurità, o delle esplosioni per spazzare via il fumo, le prendi e basta.

jp: 自信はないけど、おそらく混沌と幻惑に耐性があったほうがいいと思。
jp_grezzo: "自信はないけど、おそらく混沌と幻惑に耐性があったほうがいいと思" + _u(3) + "。"
en: I'm not sure if it will work, but I'd probably want to increase my resistance to chaos and mind damage.
en_grezzo: "I'm not sure if it will work, but I'd probably want to increase my resistance to chaos and mind damage."
it: Non ne sono sicuro, ma probabilmente conviene avere resistenza al caos e resistenza mentale.

jp: 身に着けている鏡は、混沌と魔法に耐性を持ち、それ以外の魔法も一部反射するとされている。魔法攻撃を中心に挑むと苦戦するはずだから、使えそうな攻撃アイテムや攻撃技能もピックアップしておくといい。どうしても魔法で攻めたいなら混沌と魔法属性以外で。自分はその属性への耐性を高めておくこともに忘れずに。
jp_grezzo: "身に着けている鏡は、混沌と魔法に耐性を持ち、それ以外の魔法も一部反射するとされている" + _na(3) + "。魔法攻撃を中心に挑むと苦戦するはずだから、使えそうな攻撃アイテムや攻撃技能もピックアップしておくといい" + _daro(3) + "。どうしても魔法で攻めたいなら混沌と魔法属性以外で。自分はその属性への耐性を高めておくこともに忘れずに" + _na(3) + "。"
en: The mirror he's wearing is said to be resistant to chaos and magic, and also reflects some other types of magic. If you want to attack with magic, you'll have a hard time, so it'd be a good idea to bring along some offensive items and skills that might be useful. If you really want to attack with magic, use something other than chaos and magic attributes. Don't forget to build up your resistance to those attributes as well.
en_grezzo: "The mirror he's wearing is said to be resistant to chaos and magic, and also reflects some other types of magic. If you want to attack with magic, you'll have a hard time, so it'd be a good idea to bring along some offensive items and skills that might be useful. If you really want to attack with magic, use something other than chaos and magic attributes. Don't forget to build up your resistance to those attributes as well."
it: Lo specchio che porta addosso, dicono, resiste al caos e alla magia, e riflette anche una parte delle altre magie. Puntando soprattutto sull'attacco magico farai fatica, quindi tieni pronti anche oggetti e abilità d'attacco che possano servire. Se proprio vuoi attaccare con la magia, usa qualcosa che non sia caos né elemento magia. E non dimenticare di alzare anche la tua resistenza a quegli elementi.

jp: さすがに情報が少なすぎてわからない。でもこっちだって伊逹に長年情報屋をやってるわけじゃない。ちょっと考えてみる。
jp_grezzo: "さすがに情報が少なすぎてわからない" + _yo(3) + "。でもこっちだって伊逹に長年情報屋をやってるわけじゃない" + _nda(3) + "。ちょっと考えてみる" + _ka(3) + "。"
en: Even for someone like me whose job it is to seek out information about everything there is, I'm finding myself at the end of my rope here. But it's not like I've been an informer for that many years, anyway. Let's think this over for a bit.
en_grezzo: "Even for someone like me whose job it is to seek out information about everything there is, I'm finding myself at the end of my rope here. But it's not like I've been an informer for that many years, anyway. Let's think this over for a bit."
it: Qui davvero le informazioni sono troppo poche e non ci arrivo. Ma non faccio l'informatore da tanti anni per finta. Fammici pensare un attimo.

jp: まず拘束されていて動けないだろうけど、魔力で引き寄せてくるかもしれないし油断は禁物。テレポートを防止する装備があればそんな心配もいらないかもしれない。
jp_grezzo: "まず拘束されていて動けないだろうけど、魔力で引き寄せてくるかもしれないし油断は禁物" + _da(3) + "。テレポートを防止する装備があればそんな心配もいらないかもしれない" + _na(3) + "。"
en: First of all, the adversary is bound and won't be able to move, but he might be able to draw you in with his magic, so don't let your guard down. If you have equipment that prevents teleportation, then you might not have to worry about that.
en_grezzo: "First of all, the adversary is bound and won't be able to move, but he might be able to draw you in with his magic, so don't let your guard down. If you have equipment that prevents teleportation, then you might not have to worry about that."
it: Intanto sarà legato e non potrà muoversi, ma potrebbe tirarti a sé col potere magico, quindi niente distrazioni. Con un equipaggiamento che impedisce il teletrasporto forse non c'è nemmeno da preoccuparsi.

jp: 混沌を司っている以上、混沌耐性は高いだろうし、混沌の精霊を召喚することも考えられる。召喚対策やMP回復手段を用意しておくべき。
jp_grezzo: "混沌を司っている以上、混沌耐性は高いだろうし、混沌の精霊を召喚することも考えられる" + _yo(3) + "。召喚対策やMP回復手段を用意しておくべき" + _da(3) + "。"
en: Since he's the master of Chaos itself, his chaos resistance ought to be pretty high, and he'll probably summon chaotic spirits as well. You should have a way of preventing him from summoning things and a method of recovering MP.
en_grezzo: "Since he's the master of Chaos itself, his chaos resistance ought to be pretty high, and he'll probably summon chaotic spirits as well. You should have a way of preventing him from summoning things and a method of recovering MP."
it: Dato che governa il caos, la resistenza al caos ce l'avrà alta, ed è pensabile che evochi spiriti del caos. Meglio prepararsi contro le evocazioni e con un modo per recuperare MP.

jp: 相手の攻撃もやはり混沌属性が中心？いや、それ以外にも何か使うかもしれないし耐性は一通り揃えて損はない。埋まらない穴は属性耐性のポーションでどうにかなると思いたい。
jp_grezzo: "相手の攻撃もやはり混沌属性が中心" + _kana(3) + "？いや、それ以外にも何か使うかもしれないし耐性は一通り揃えて損はない" + _daro(3) + "。埋まらない穴は属性耐性のポーションでどうにかなると思いたい" + _na(3) + "。"
en: Since this is Chaos we're talking about, maybe his attacks will be mostly chaos-based? ...No, he might have something else up his sleeve, and it wouldn't hurt to come packing a full set of strong resistances anyway. I'd like to think that a potion of resistance could help fill in the gaps that might be left over.
en_grezzo: "Since this is Chaos we're talking about, maybe his attacks will be mostly chaos-based? ...No, he might have something else up his sleeve, and it wouldn't hurt to come packing a full set of strong resistances anyway. I'd like to think that a potion of resistance could help fill in the gaps that might be left over."
it: Anche i suoi attacchi saranno soprattutto d'elemento caos? No, potrebbe usare anche altro, e avere tutte le resistenze in ordine non fa male. I buchi che restano spero si tappino con una pozione di resistenza.

jp: もし迂闊に近づいただけで死ぬような相手だった時は、ひたすら逃げ回ってパターンを見極めたり時間を稼ぐのもありじゃない。そのうち後続の冒険者が追いついてきて、状況が変わるかもしれないし。
jp_grezzo: "もし迂闊に近づいただけで死ぬような相手だった時は、ひたすら逃げ回ってパターンを見極めたり時間を稼ぐのもありじゃない" + _kana(3) + "。そのうち後続の冒険者が追いついてきて、状況が変わるかもしれないし。"
en: If you find yourself about to perish from carelessly getting too close, you might as well just keep running around, try to figure out his attack patterns and buy yourself some time. Eventually, the other party of adventurers on their way might catch up to you and help turn the tables.
en_grezzo: "If you find yourself about to perish from carelessly getting too close, you might as well just keep running around, try to figure out his attack patterns and buy yourself some time. Eventually, the other party of adventurers on their way might catch up to you and help turn the tables."
it: Se ti trovi davanti uno che ti ammazza solo ad avvicinarti per sbaglio, ci sta anche scappare in tondo per capire gli schemi e guadagnare tempo. Intanto gli avventurieri che vengono dopo ti raggiungono, e la situazione può cambiare.

jp: 状況から見て、太古の昔より伝わる儀式…「人狼遊儀」で間違いない。
jp_grezzo: "状況から見て、太古の昔より伝わる儀式…「人狼遊儀」で間違いない" + _daro(3) + "。"
en: Judging from the current situation, this is undoubtedly the works of an ancient ritual... \ncalled the <Werewolf-Ritual-Game>.
en_grezzo: "Judging from the current situation, this is undoubtedly the works of an ancient ritual... \ncalled the <Werewolf-Ritual-Game>."
it: A vedere come stanno le cose, non c'è dubbio: è un rito che viene dalla notte dei tempi... \nsi chiama <Il Gioco Rituale del Lupo Mannaro>.

jp: 儀式の内容はこう。狼が人間に化けて人里に潜り込み、深夜に一人ずつ住人を生贄として捧げていく。強い者を捧げるほど儀式はより早く進行し、一定段階に到達すると神狼が降臨。その後は狼たちの支配する餌場となり果てるってわけ。狼が数匹でそのまま暴れてもあっという間に駆除されてしまうから、こういう手段を取っているの。
jp_grezzo: "儀式の内容はこう" + _da(3) + "。狼が人間に化けて人里に潜り込み、深夜に一人ずつ住人を生贄として捧げていく。強い者を捧げるほど儀式はより早く進行し、一定段階に到達すると神狼が降臨。その後は狼たちの支配する餌場となり果てるってわけ" + _da(3) + "。狼が数匹でそのまま暴れてもあっという間に駆除されてしまうから、こういう手段を取っているの" + _daro(3) + "。"
en: The procedure of the ritual are as follows: \nA wolf disguises itself as a human, sneaks into a human village, and sacrifices the residents one by one in the middle of the night. \nThe more powerful the sacrifice is, the faster the ritual progresses, and when a critical mass of sacrifice is offered, the wolf-god will be summoned. After that, the town will become a feeding ground dominated by wolves. If a few wolves assault the town, they would be exterminated in no time, so they probably took this method instead.
en_grezzo: "The procedure of the ritual are as follows: \nA wolf disguises itself as a human, sneaks into a human village, and sacrifices the residents one by one in the middle of the night. \nThe more powerful the sacrifice is, the faster the ritual progresses, and when a critical mass of sacrifice is offered, the wolf-god will be summoned. After that, the town will become a feeding ground dominated by wolves. If a few wolves assault the town, they would be exterminated in no time, so they probably took this method instead."
it: Il rito funziona così: \nun lupo prende sembianze umane, si infila fra la gente e a notte fonda offre in sacrificio gli abitanti, uno per volta. \nPiù forte è chi viene offerto, più il rito corre; e arrivato a un certo punto scende il <Lupo Divino>. Da lì in poi il posto finisce a fare da mangiatoia sotto il dominio dei lupi. Se quattro lupi si mettessero a menare così com'è li sterminerebbero in un attimo: ecco perché prendono questa strada.

jp: この儀式の厄介なところは、普通の方法で人狼を全滅させても終わらないこと。儀式の進行手段の反対…真昼に一匹ずつ人狼を特殊な方法で処刑していき、全滅させることでのみ、儀式が相殺されるらしい。
jp_grezzo: "この儀式の厄介なところは、普通の方法で人狼を全滅させても終わらないこと" + _da(3) + "。儀式の進行手段の反対…真昼に一匹ずつ人狼を特殊な方法で処刑していき、全滅させることでのみ、儀式が相殺されるらしい" + _nda(3) + "。"
en: The troublesome thing about this ritual is that it doesn't end even if you wipe out all the werewolves using normal methods. It is said that we have to go for the opposite of the ritual's method... It is said that the ritual is offset by executing the werewolves one by one in the middle of the day using a special method.
en_grezzo: "The troublesome thing about this ritual is that it doesn't end even if you wipe out all the werewolves using normal methods. It is said that we have to go for the opposite of the ritual's method... It is said that the ritual is offset by executing the werewolves one by one in the middle of the day using a special method."
it: La cosa fastidiosa di questo rito è che non finisce nemmeno sterminando i lupi mannari col metodo normale. Bisogna fare il contrario di come avanza il rito... si dice che il rito si annulli soltanto giustiziando i lupi mannari uno per volta, in pieno giorno, con un metodo speciale.

jp: 怪しい人物を一日中見張っても人狼を見つけようとしている、おそらく日数が足りない。紛らわしいことに、妖狐が人狼遊儀の乗っ取りを目論んで混ざっていることもあるそう。とにかく、の冒険者の勘にも期待している。
jp_grezzo: "怪しい人物を一日中見張って" + _ore(3) + "も人狼を見つけようとしている" + _ga(3) + "、おそらく日数が足りない" + _daro(3) + "。紛らわしいことに、妖狐が人狼遊儀の乗っ取りを目論んで混ざっていることもあるそう" + _da(3) + "。とにかく、" + _kimi(3) + "の冒険者の勘にも期待している" + _yo(3) + "。"
en: I've been watching all day for suspicious people, trying to find the werewolf, but I probably won't have enough time. Confusingly, foxes are sometimes mixed in with the intention of taking over the ritual. Anyway, I have high hopes for your adventurer's intuition.
en_grezzo: "I've been watching all day for suspicious people, trying to find the werewolf, but I probably won't have enough time. Confusingly, foxes are sometimes mixed in with the intention of taking over the ritual. Anyway, I have high hopes for your adventurer's intuition."
it: Anche a sorvegliare tutto il giorno le persone sospette per trovare il lupo mannaro, probabilmente i giorni non bastano. E per complicare le cose, a volte ci si mette in mezzo una volpe ammaliatrice che punta a impadronirsi del rito. Comunque: conto anche sul tuo fiuto di avventuriero.
